title: The Quiet Threshold / 静默的门槛
input_provenance: AI-generated fictional architectural photograph; no real location is represented.
pipeline: Generate a photographic input, inspect it, then edit that exact image using it as the reference.

before.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create an original architectural editorial photograph of a fictional Mediterranean courtyard with no identifiable real-world location. Portrait 4:5 composition. A beautifully restrained sun-bleached white lime-plaster exterior: a narrow masonry stair rises from the lower left foreground to a small landing near the center, turns once, and continues to a deep cobalt-blue wooden door set in a simple rounded arch in the upper right half. The stair has believable connected treads, risers, landing and a low solid plaster parapet; architecturally coherent perspective, nothing floating or mechanically impossible. A modest olive tree at the lower right edge contributes just a few thin branches with grey-green leaves, reaching into the white space without obscuring the steps or door. A tiny portion of clear pale-blue sky at the top. Strong clean late-afternoon sunlight creates a long, very legible hard-edged diagonal shadow across a large wall plane, with gentle nuanced reflected light inside shade. Camera from the courtyard at human eye level looking slightly up, disciplined architectural photography with corrected verticals, no wide-angle distortion. The composition has a clear graphic rhythm of steps, one arch, one blue color plane and large quiet off-white planes. Actual tactile limewash, tiny worn chips on step noses, subtly weathered blue painted boards, restrained imperfections rather than distressed ruin. The image should feel observed and specific, calm but visually arresting, with rich blue balanced against warm sunlit white. No people, no text, signs, potted flowers, furniture, railing clutter, branding, watermark, frame, or collage. No illustration, 3D render, over-saturated vacation advertising, fake picturesque decorations, or excessive objects. A finished photographic input image for a subsequent image-to-art transformation.

after.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit the supplied architectural photograph into one finished Soul Imprint / 灵魂拓印 artwork. The photograph is the only source of architecture and composition. Preserve the exact portrait 4:5 framing and viewpoint; the same stair treads and their connected upward path from lower left toward upper right, the rounded parapet, the same tall arched wooden door in the upper right, its board seams and small ring pull, and the olive branches and trunk along the right edge. Do not redesign the building, change the count or spacing of visible steps, move the door, straighten the composition into an elevation, or add any objects.

Convert every visible surface into selective tactile graphite transfer on luminous neutral-white thin paper. No photographic surfaces remain. The recognizable architecture must emerge from a few confident impressions surrounded by substantial missing information: crisp dark dry graphite at some chipped stair noses, short segments of the arch, a few door-board seams and the small ring pull; adjacent graphite is broken into irregular intermediate deposits that dissolve into genuinely blank paper. Keep enough of the stepped progression to read the depth and continuity immediately. The former cobalt-blue door becomes the most substantial grey-black impression, but it is internally punctuated by irregular unprinted paper areas and short slivers of board grain, not a smooth shaded black arch. The shadow that was a giant triangle on the left wall becomes only a sparse, airy veil of contact-like grain along portions of its diagonal boundary, with the broad wall plane almost entirely untouched white. Let the parapet face largely disappear while retaining a few pieces of its flowing edge. Olive leaves become scattered small directional marks in their original branch pattern; branches and trunk recede through intermittent fragments, keeping the tree secondary.

This is a poetic image transfer, not a small-scale model wrapped in paper and not an ordinary pencil drawing. Use dry broken impressions with pressure variation and missing patches. Preserve irregular granular deposits at selected edges and surface fragments; do not cover all surfaces with a uniform noise filter. No continuous architectural outlining, no pencil hatch shading, no photorealistic volume, no even reduction of opacity, no grayscale photograph with paper texture. Provide distinct strong fragments, quiet mid-tones, and true absence. Aim for restrained but visually compelling balance: the dark fragmented doorway anchors the upper right, the stair traces lead the eye from the bottom, the left wall becomes expansive luminous space. The architecture is recognizable and calm, while much of its material has withdrawn.

Fresh, very thin neutral to slightly cool white kozo paper fills the image edge to edge, subtle fibers visible only on close inspection. A couple of almost invisible paper handling traces may exist in empty margins but should not cut across the arch or stairs. No sepia, yellow paper, all-over wrinkles, artificial distress, decorative stains, parchment or blueprint blue. No new text, title, numbers, signature, mat, frame, border, gallery view, physical objects resting on paper or cast object shadows. Finished flat art reproduction, one image only, no before-and-after layout.

quality_review: Reviewed both images. The doorway, visible stair progression, parapet, camera framing and olive branches remain recognizable. Tonal wall surfaces are selectively removed, while wood grain, arch and tread edges carry the stronger marks. This pair is an AI-generated demonstration, not a physical rubbing or a real-location record.
